question.description: The question that the habit asks each day, such as "Did you read today?".

unit.description: The unit of a number habit, such as minutes.

target.description: The target of a number habit for one day. With no target, any value above 0 is done.

type.description: atLeast: the day is done when its value reaches the target (the default). atMost: when its value stays at the target or under it.

frequency.description: Read as "times in days": { "times": 3, "days": 7 } is three times a week, { "times": 1, "days": 3 } is every 3 days.

checks.description: One check for each day that the person did the habit. A number habit gives the day's value.

skips.description: The days that the person skipped on purpose, such as a sick day. A skip keeps the streak and does not lower the strength.

color.description: The colour of the habit, as #rrggbb, such as #3b82f6.

archived.description: true for a habit that the person stopped tracking. The widget hides it, and keeps its history.
